title: fix: #6054 preserve heading folds when switching tabs
issueTitle: [Bug] 文件A点击H1~H6折叠内容后，切换到文件B，再切换回文件A，文件A之前的折叠内容被还原
why: The report gives a clear expected result: after you fold a heading, switch to another tab and switch back, the content under that heading should still be hidden. A tab switch and a fold click can both be done inside the editor.
